name: Credo Ventures
note: Prague-based early-stage VC (founded 2009) investing in CEE tech; appears in nearly every Czech VC list.

name: KAYA VC (Enern)
note: Prague early-stage VC that grew out of Enern (founded 2010), raising its fifth fund and named VC Fund Manager at the CVCA & SLOVCA Awards.

name: Presto Ventures
note: Prague pre-seed/seed fund founded 2016, among the most active Czech funds by deal count.

name: N1 (Nation 1)
note: Czech/CEE pre-seed and seed fund (formerly Nation 1), reported to be backed by the EIF and raising a second fund.

name: DEPO Ventures
note: Prague pre-seed/seed VC that also runs angel syndicates and was among the top Czech funds by number of investments.

name: J&T Ventures
note: Corporate-backed (J&T group) seed/Series A fund investing in CEE tech, with about EUR 40M under management per Vestbee.

name: Reflex Capital
note: Prague investment group of entrepreneurs investing its own money in early-stage software, closing a third fund of roughly CZK 500M.

name: Purple Ventures
note: Brno-based pre-seed/seed VC raising its second fund (target EUR 40M).

name: Czech Founders VC
note: Pre-seed fund set up by Czech entrepreneurs to back Czech founders.

name: Lighthouse Ventures
note: Prague VC and accelerator (about EUR 24M under management) investing in seed-stage tech.

name: Tensor Ventures
note: Invitation-only Prague deep-tech VC and first manager in the EIF-backed Czech fund of funds, per CVCA and EIF listings.

name: Tilia Impact Ventures
note: Prague impact-focused VC, listed by CVCA as an honorary member and by the EIF as a fund partner (Tilia Impact Ventures Fund II).

name: Impulse Ventures
note: Hands-on sector-agnostic CEE VC investing from seed to Series A.

name: Air Ventures
note: Europe-focused early-growth fund investing EUR 200k-2M from late seed to Series A.

name: Koopeo Ventures
note: Prague-based fund (founded 1995 per Vestbee) investing EUR 200k-500k in CEE internet and e-commerce companies.

name: ZAKA VC
note: Prague-based (Slovak-founded) family-office-turned-VC writing first cheques into pre-seed/seed software startups.

name: Soulmates Ventures
note: Prague firm backing green-innovation startups from seed on, described by CzechStartups as a green-investing accelerator.

name: STARTGUIDE VC
note: Prague investor providing pre-seed, seed and bridge funding to early-stage CEE startups.

name: Springtide Ventures (KKCG)
note: Venture arm of the KKCG group investing seed to later-stage SaaS in Europe and Israel; its former partners launched Tachles.

name: Tachles VC
note: New fund (target over CZK 1B) launched by former Springtide partners; one article calls it the renamed Springtide, which needs checking.

name: Pale Fire Capital
note: Prague private-equity/investment group (founded 2015) backing tech companies from seed to growth.

name: Rockaway Capital (Rockaway Ventures)
note: Prague investment group (Mall, Heureka, Rohlik lineage) investing seed to growth, with the Rockaway Ventures fund launched in 2022.

name: RockawayX
note: Web3/crypto-focused venture platform listed as a separate entry next to Rockaway in a Prague VC list.

name: Miton
note: Invests only its own capital (no external LPs) in e-commerce, AI and digital consumer companies.

name: QQ Capital
note: Prague venture family office led by Michal Stencl, backing early-stage technology startups.

name: Fazole Ventures
note: Early-stage investor backing promising projects.

name: Patero
note: Prague investment firm (founded 2015) making direct venture investments in early-stage startups such as Flowpay; website taken from a search-result directory profile.

name: Zero Gravity Capital
note: Bratislava-based pre-seed/seed fund linked to a Czech family-office sponsor, named as an investor in CEE rounds.

name: BD Partners
note: Prague investment vehicle of Ladislav Bartonicek and Jean-Pascal Duvieusart (ex-PPF) co-investing in startups and other assets.

name: SFG Holding
note: Prague firm mixing venture investing with real-estate financing; counted with five Czech-founder startup investments in a CzechCrunch review.

name: RSJ Investments
note: Multi-strategy international investment group that operates venture vehicles.

name: Thein
note: Prague investment group (founded 2020) running Thein Digital and Thein Industry funds; CVCA lists it as a full member.

name: Inven Capital (ČEZ)
note: Corporate venture fund of the ČEZ group investing in cleantech/smart-energy startups, co-financed by the EIB.

name: Y Soft Ventures
note: Corporate venture arm of Brno-based Y Soft investing in and incubating CEE B2B hardware/software startups.

name: KB SmartSolutions
note: Komerční banka subsidiary developing fintech services, listed as corporate VC on the CzechStartups portal.

name: Seed Starter ČS (Česká spořitelna)
note: Corporate venture programme of Česká spořitelna backing startups relevant to banking.

name: mAccelerator.vc (mBank)
note: mBank-backed venture fund investing in early-stage digital-economy startups.

name: Genesis Capital
note: Czech private-equity manager investing in SMEs in CEE (about EUR 500M in funds), named PE Fund Manager of the year at the CVCA & SLOVCA Awards.

name: ARX Equity Partners
note: Czech buyout/growth private-equity firm; EIF fund partner and winner of a PE Deal of the Year award.

name: EVERITA Capital
note: Lower-mid-market private-equity manager (EUR 2-5M tickets) with an EIF-backed fund, listed by CVCA.

name: Orbit Capital (OGD Advisory)
note: Czech private-credit and growth-debt manager (Orbit Growth Debt II) with EIF participation.

name: Jet Investment
note: Czech PE/VC firm with a representative on the CVCA board and a profile on a PE directory.

name: Stratum Partners
note: Czech/Slovak growth-equity and buyout firm (about EUR 40M under management) listed among CVCA full members.

name: Enterprise Investors
note: Private-equity firm with over EUR 2.5B in funds and three Czech deals, listed among CVCA full members.

name: Mid Europa Partners
note: Private-equity firm with about EUR 5.2B under management and Czech holdings, listed among CVCA full members.

name: Fond rizikového kapitálu, s.r.o.
note: Early Czech PE fund founded in 1995 by Michal Nosek, with 11 investments.

name: StartupYard
note: Prague accelerator providing seed investment and mentoring to early-stage startups.

name: JIC (JIC Ventures / JIC STARCUBE)
note: South Moravian Innovation Centre running the JIC STARCUBE accelerator and listed as an active VC on directories.

name: AI Startup Incubator
note: Accelerator focused on AI startups in the Czech Republic.

name: HitHit
note: Czech reward-based crowdfunding platform (over 2,000 projects).

name: Fundlift
note: Investment crowdfunding platform matching investors with companies via convertible certificates or minibonds.

name: Investown
note: Czech crowdfunding/real-estate investment platform reported to have received a CNB investment-crowdfunding licence.

name: Garage Angels
note: Investor group of business angels backing early-stage startups, mainly from South Moravia.

name: Czech Private Equity and Venture Capital Association (CVCA)
note: Industry association of PE/VC funds in the Czech Republic (not an investor itself).

name: JŠK (law firm)
note: Law firm named best advisor at the CVCA & SLOVCA Awards and listed among CVCA associate members.

name: CzechInvest
note: Czech state agency promoting investment and startups (runs Czechia Dealroom, CEE Funding Map partner), not a VC fund.

name: European Investment Fund (EIF)
note: EU fund-of-funds that has committed about EUR 300M to 15 Czech equity funds, investing in funds rather than startups.

name: EBRD (EBRD Venture Capital)
note: Multilateral bank that returned to direct investment in Czechia in 2021 and appears as a VC investor in a CVCA-awarded exit.

name: Národní rozvojová banka (NRB)
note: State development bank (ex-ČMZRB) that co-runs the Central Europe Fund of Funds and has invested in Czech VC/PE funds.

name: Seed Fund (Český rozvojový uzavřený investiční fond)
note: Government co-investment programme backed by CZK 660M of EU funds requiring at least 30% private co-investment.
